output.summary: Reported on-time gains coincide with the bonus start, not RouteWise. Revisions jumped about 5x at each center when its bonus took effect (Northgate and Riverside in March, Pell Junction in July). Northgate's RouteWise go-live came only in October. The revised mix shifted to Operational-Capacity, entered late and rarely notified to customers. Brightwell's receiving logs show 81% against 87% a year earlier, and lateness complaints rose 35% while damage and billing complaints stayed flat. The metric appears gamed and real timeliness probably worsened. The driver shortage is plausible but unproven, since original-date performance was never analysed. Suspend external use of the figure and recompute against original dates. Re-base the incentive. Hold the campaign, the bonus increase and the hiring plan.
